description: This C# source file defines a pipeline behavior for handling database transactions within the Conduit.Infrastructure namespace. It implements the IPipelineBehavior interface from MediatR to wrap request handling within a transaction scope, ensuring commit or rollback based on success or failure.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions for each request, ensuring data consistency by handling begin, commit, and rollback of transactions.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles a request, wrapping execution with transaction management: begins a transaction, calls the next delegate, commits if successful, or rolls back in case of exceptions.
